summary: Sensorik Ammertal GmbH, 150-staff pressure-sensor maker bought by an investor in June 2026; we are 1.2 % of its turnover; it is our sole source. Head office has frozen all price reductions until December 2027, but it is open on payment terms and call-off flexibility. Price is 2.9 % over its should-cost. Contract ends 2026-12-31. Hold the price flat and win value through terms and quality.
notes: Contradiction: a private firm citing a 'head office' directive. Historically it gave way, settling far below its asks. Quality is weak: 17 complaints in three years and OTD 80-92 % against a 95 % target. Our spend is falling 2.6 %.

evidence.quote: head office has frozen all price reductions until December 2027.
Prices as per current list; discounts not possible this year (head-office directive).
price changes above 2 % need the approval of their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks.

avoid: repeating price-cut demands against the freeze
threatening a second source we do not have
changing terms after a final offer
tactics: Hold 23.13; the freeze blocks cuts, not our refusal of any increase.
Trade a binding volume and a 24-36 month contract for price stability.
Ask for value in terms it offered: payment days and call-off flexibility.
Use the complaint record once as the quality argument.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; it historically settled well below its asks (kept -0.16), but the new freeze means expect terms, not price cuts.
